# Anna Milaeva

> IFS coach for people in transition. Anna Milaeva works with professionals in the middle of a change (a job, a marriage, a team that stopped working, the chapter after a degree) using Internal Family Systems (IFS). In the same sessions she helps clients build the practical side of what comes next: plans, CVs, hard conversations, and AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT set up around their real work. Online, in English and Spanish.

Anna is trained at the IFS Institute through Level 3, its highest level, and is a Certified Deep Transformational Coach. She has more than ten years in operations (chief of staff, operations and project management in real estate, fintech and health tech), and has worked with clients in more than 15 countries. She is the author of the novel *Already in a Meeting* (Spanish edition: *La reunión ya empezó*) and the workbook *The Self-Journal*. Coaching is not therapy.

## Work with Anna

- [1:1 Coaching](https://annamilaeva.com/coaching): IFS coaching, inner work and outer work in the same sessions. Single session $105, four sessions $380.
- [Self-Quest](https://annamilaeva.com/self-quest): an eight-week 1:1 IFS program through the eight qualities of Self-leadership. $1,250.
- [AI Coaching (AI Clarity)](https://annamilaeva.com/ai-clarity): hands-on AI setup for professionals in transition, inside coaching, including the inner resistance to new tools. Session $135, four-week program $750.
- [Sacred Circles](https://annamilaeva.com/sacred-circles): seven-week small-group IFS circles with Dario Giuffrida. $220 per circle.
- [Couples Coaching](https://annamilaeva.com/couples): IFS-based couples work with her husband Dario Giuffrida, an organizational psychologist trained in IFS. Programs from $1,550, immersive from $2,550.
- [Teams and companies](https://www.fino.website): organizational work through FINO.
- [Book a free 30-minute intro call](https://calendly.com/annamilaeva/discovery-call-with-anna)
